env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd cross
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cross$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/cross$GOEXE
stdout '^crosspkg-ok$'
logos run ./cmd
stdout '^crosspkg-ok$'
logos eject -o eject
exists eject/go.mod
cd eject
go build ./lib ./cmd
go run ./cmd
stdout '^crosspkg-ok$'
cd ../..

cd neg
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negslice$GOEXE ./negslice
stderr 'cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negmap$GOEXE ./negmap
stderr 'cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negfunc$GOEXE ./negfunc
stderr 'cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negchan$GOEXE ./negchan
stderr 'cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/neggeneric$GOEXE ./neggeneric
stderr 'cannot use|const_view'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negmutate$GOEXE ./negmutate
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

-- cross/go.mod --
module example.com/cross

go 1.27

-- cross/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

func SliceFn(xs const []int) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func MapFn(m const map[string]int, k string) int {
	return m[k] ?? 0
}

func ArrayFn(a const [3]int) int {
	return a[0] + a[1] + a[2]
}

type Config struct {
	N    int
	Name string
}

func PtrFn(p const *Config) int {
	return p.N
}

func VariadicFn(xs ...const []int) int {
	n := 0
	for _, s := range xs {
		for _, v := range s {
			n += v
		}
	}
	return n
}

type Getter interface {
	Get(xs const []int) int
}

func Use(g Getter, xs const []int) int {
	return g.Get(xs)
}

type C struct {
	V int
}

func (c const *C) Get() int {
	return c.V
}

-- cross/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cross/lib"
)

type Impl struct{}

func (Impl) Get(xs const []int) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	xs := []int{1, 2, 3}
	if got := lib.SliceFn(xs); got != 6 {
		fmt.Println("slice-bad")
		return
	}
	m := map[string]int{"a": 2}
	if got := lib.MapFn(m, "a"); got != 2 {
		fmt.Println("map-bad")
		return
	}
	a := [3]int{1, 2, 3}
	if got := lib.ArrayFn(a); got != 6 {
		fmt.Println("array-bad")
		return
	}
	c := &lib.Config{N: 7, Name: "s"}
	if got := lib.PtrFn(c); got != 7 {
		fmt.Println("ptr-bad")
		return
	}
	av := []int{1}
	bv := []int{2}
	if got := lib.VariadicFn(av, bv); got != 3 {
		fmt.Println("variadic-bad")
		return
	}
	var g lib.Getter = Impl{}
	if got := lib.Use(g, []int{1, 2}); got != 3 {
		fmt.Println("iface-bad")
		return
	}
	rc := &lib.C{V: 5}
	if got := rc.Get(); got != 5 {
		fmt.Println("recv-bad")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("crosspkg-ok")
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/neg

go 1.27

-- neg/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

func SliceNested(xs []const []int) int {
	n := 0
	for _, s := range xs {
		for _, v := range s {
			n += v
		}
	}
	return n
}

func MapNested(m map[string]const []int) int {
	s := m["a"] ?? []int{}
	n := 0
	for _, v := range s {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func FuncParam(f func(const []int) int, xs const []int) int {
	return f(xs)
}

type BoxNested struct {
	F func(const []int) int
	S []const []int
	Ch chan const []int
}

func UseBoxNested(b BoxNested, xs const []int) int {
	return b.F(xs)
}

func ChanFn(c chan const []int) int {
	return 1
}

type G[T any] struct {
	X T
}

func UseG(g G[const []int]) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range g.X {
		n += v
	}
	return n
}

func GetConst() const []int {
	return []int{1, 2}
}

-- neg/negslice/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func main() {
	xs := [][]int{{1, 2}}
	fmt.Println(lib.SliceNested(xs))
}

-- neg/negmap/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func main() {
	m := map[string][][]int{"a": {{1}}}
	fmt.Println(lib.MapNested(m))
}

-- neg/negfunc/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func plain(xs []int) int {
	return len(xs)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(lib.FuncParam(plain, []int{1}))
}

-- neg/negchan/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func main() {
	c := make(chan []int, 1)
	fmt.Println(lib.ChanFn(c))
}

-- neg/neggeneric/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func main() {
	g := lib.G[const []int]{X: []int{1}}
	fmt.Println(lib.UseG(g))
}

-- neg/negmutate/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/neg/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.GetConst()[0] = 1
}
